name: Flying! Primeval Earth | Dinosaur Survival
desc:
🦖 Welcome to Primeval Earth! Embark on a prehistoric adventure as you enter a world of dinosaurs on a mysterious island, ready to explore and thrive with friends. Will you team up to face the challenges together, or embrace the wild as a fierce lone carnivore on the hunt?

🌿 Explore a living prehistoric world.
🦖 Play as dinosaurs and other prehistoric creatures.
⚔️ Hunt, survive, and compete with other players.
🌎 Discover a world full of dangers and events.
